summary.ja: 非線形方程式 F(x)=0 を、Jacobianから求めたNewton方向と残差ノルムの十分減少による減衰で解く。公開例は密行列解法または前処理付きGMRESの内部解法を選べる。 追加固定例：擬似弧長継続でBratuのfoldを越える。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Solve F(x)=0 using a Jacobian-based Newton direction and damping that requires sufficient decrease of the residual norm. The example supports a dense or preconditioned GMRES inner solve. Additional fixed examples: Crossing the Bratu fold with pseudo-arclength continuation. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

references.label: Armijo, L. (1966). Minimization of functions having Lipschitz continuous first partial derivatives.
references.scope: Source for sufficient-decrease and halving-backtracking ideas; the atlas adapts the test to ||F||, not to the paper's steepest-descent problem.

supports.ja: 十分減少と刻みの半減という考え方の根拠。原論文の最小化の収束定理を、この非線形方程式実装の保証とはしない。
supports.en: Supports sufficient decrease and step halving; the minimization theorem is not a convergence certificate for this root solver.

verification.locator: Printed pp. 1–3; convergence theorem and Corollary 2, equation (2).

references.label: Dembo, R. S., Eisenstat, S. C. & Steihaug, T. (1982). Inexact Newton Methods.
references.scope: Newton equations and approximate inner linear solves; context for the GMRES path, not proof of the atlas's particular forcing rule.

supports.ja: Newton方程式を近似的に解く定式化。今回確認したのは抄録であり、実装固有の内部許容誤差の定理適合は未確認。
supports.en: Formulates approximate Newton solves; only the abstract was reviewed, not a theorem audit of the implemented inner tolerance.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata, as returned by web search; direct full text not reviewed.

assumptions: The caller supplies F and its Jacobian; the basic setting is a square differentiable system with a nonsingular Jacobian near the root.
Starting at one, the step is halved until ||F(x+αs)||₂ ≤ (1−10⁻⁴α)||F(x)||₂; failure is returned below α=2⁻²⁰.
The GMRES path still uses an explicitly supplied Jacobian; CSR uses ILU(0), otherwise Jacobi preconditioning. Inner and outer absolute residual criteria differ.
units: No intrinsic physical unit; the caller defines unknown and residual scales. Components are not nondimensionalized automatically, so scale them consistently before using the norm and absolute tolerance.
boundary_conditions: Newton has no intrinsic physical boundary. F/Jacobian assembly supplies it; the existing Bratu test encodes zero Dirichlet values at both ends of [0,1].

limitations.ja: 初期値、Jacobianの非特異性、残差の尺度に依存し、大域的収束は保証しない。特異な密行列解法や前処理構築は例外となることがあり、すべてが失敗理由の戻り値に変換されるわけではない。行列なしJv、信頼領域、継続法は備えない。 追加固定例：小さな1次元の単純foldだけです。分岐曲線の解析族比較では計算した中点値を族の座標に使い、固定λの独立形状比較と区別します。連続foldは離散解そのものではなく、一般の分岐追跡や大規模性能は保証しません。
limitations.en: Convergence depends on the initial guess, Jacobian nonsingularity and residual scaling; global convergence is not guaranteed. Singular dense solves or preconditioner construction may raise exceptions rather than return a failure reason. No matrix-free Jv, trust region or continuation is provided. Additional fixed examples: A small one-dimensional simple fold only. The whole-curve family comparison uses the computed midpoint as its family coordinate and is distinct from the independent fixed-lambda profile checks. The continuum fold is not an exact discrete solution. No general bifurcation-tracking or large-scale performance claim.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

supplemental_review.level: Frozen fixed inputs, independently reviewed references and criteria, actual pytest/main and independently extracted ZIP. See release-specific scope and retained failure history.

assumptions_ja: FとJacobianを利用者が与える。平方の微分可能な系と、解の近くで非特異なJacobianが基本となる。
長さ1から1/2ずつ減らし、||F(x+αs)||₂ ≤ (1−10⁻⁴α)||F(x)||₂ を要求する。α<2⁻²⁰で失敗を返す。
GMRES経路でもJacobianは明示的に与える。CSRならILU(0)、それ以外ならJacobi前処理を使い、内部残差と外部絶対残差を区別する。
units_ja: 固有の物理単位はなく、未知数・残差の尺度は呼び出し側が決める。単位・桁の違う残差成分を自動で無次元化しないため、ノルムと絶対許容誤差を使う前に尺度を揃える。
boundary_conditions_ja: Newton法自体に物理境界はない。境界はFとJacobianの組立て側が指定する。既存Bratu検査は [0,1] の両端零Dirichletを内部未知数の残差へ組み込む。

problem.ja: 微分可能な平方の非線形連立方程式 F(x)=0。
problem.en: A differentiable square nonlinear system F(x)=0.

variant.ja: 残差ノルムのArmijo型十分減少を用いる減衰Newton。内部線形解法はdenseまたはGMRESで、Jacobianは明示指定。
variant.en: Damped Newton with an Armijo-type residual-norm decrease test; explicit Jacobian and dense/GMRES inner solve.

ja: Jacobianを与えられ、根の候補に近い初期値があるとき。
非線形問題で線形解法の誤差と減衰の作用を分けて確認するとき。
en: A Jacobian and an initial guess near a candidate root are available.
Examining the separate effects of inner linear accuracy and damping.

ja: Jacobianが特異になる点や、解が複数ある問題を初期値依存なしに解きたい場合。
制約付き最適化やJacobianなしの巨大問題をこのまま解く場合。
en: Requiring initial-guess-independent results near singular Jacobians or multiple roots.
Direct use for constrained optimization or very large Jacobian-free problems.

reason.ja: 受理不等式、半減、Jacobianと内部解法を確認した。
reason.en: Inspected the acceptance inequality, halving, Jacobian and inner solvers.

reason.ja: ソルバーによる尺度変換はなく絶対ノルムを使う。
reason.en: No automatic scaling; the solver uses an absolute norm.

reason.ja: 境界は残差とJacobianの定義に属する。
reason.en: Boundaries belong to the supplied residual/Jacobian.

reason.ja: 失敗理由と例外が返る経路を区別した。
reason.en: Distinguished returned failures from exception paths.

summary.ja: krylov.newtonと、立方関数での後退・反復上限、1次元BratuのNewton–GMRES格子細分化を扱う既存検査定義を読んだ。今回は再実行していない。
summary.en: Inspected krylov.newton and existing cubic backtracking/iteration-limit and 1D Bratu Newton–GMRES refinement tests; no rerun.

ja: 一般初期値からの大域的収束、特異点や分岐への対応。
実装固有の内部許容誤差が文献の収束定理を満たすことの証明。
en: Global convergence, singular points and bifurcations.
Proof that the implemented inner tolerance satisfies a particular literature convergence theorem.

title.ja: 擬似弧長継続でBratuのfoldを越える
title.en: Crossing the Bratu fold with pseudo-arclength continuation

summary.ja: 同じ1次元Bratu境界値問題の下枝から上枝までを追跡し、接線・fold・独立解析族との空間誤差を調べます。
summary.en: Follow the lower and upper branches of the same one-dimensional Bratu boundary-value problem; check tangents, the fold and spatial error against an independent analytic family.

assumptions.ja: 無次元x∈[0,1]、両端u=0、中心差分の内点31/63/127。零解から固定ds=0.1で80step。λ=2で上下枝を補正し、λ=4は離散無解の意図的な対照です。擬似弧長は物理時間ではありません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet endpoints and 31/63/127 interior nodes. Take 80 fixed ds=0.1 steps from the zero solution. Correct both branches at lambda=2; lambda=4 is a deliberate discrete no-solution control. Pseudo-arclength is not physical time.

algorithm.ja: hΣdu²+dλ²の重み付き単位接線、予測点と接線超平面によるNewton補正。別の拡大系でfoldと正規化null vectorを解きます。このcaseは疎Jacobianを明示的に組み立てます。
algorithm.en: Use a unit tangent in h-sum(du squared)+d-lambda squared, a predictor and a tangent-hyperplane Newton corrector. A separate augmented system locates the fold and a normalized null vector. This case deliberately assembles sparse Jacobians.

validation.ja: 保存R3では共通27pytestと本caseの67固定判定が合格。離散残差、接線の向き・単位長、fold方程式・null条件・transversality、独立Decimal80解析族、固定3格子の誤差を別々に確認しています。
validation.en: The preserved R3 run passed the shared 27 pytest tests and this case’s 67 fixed gates. Discrete residuals, tangent orientation/normalization, fold/null/transversality conditions, an independent Decimal80 family and fixed three-grid errors are checked separately.

limits.ja: 小さな1次元の単純foldだけです。分岐曲線の解析族比較では計算した中点値を族の座標に使い、固定λの独立形状比較と区別します。連続foldは離散解そのものではなく、一般の分岐追跡や大規模性能は保証しません。
limits.en: A small one-dimensional simple fold only. The whole-curve family comparison uses the computed midpoint as its family coordinate and is distinct from the independent fixed-lambda profile checks. The continuum fold is not an exact discrete solution. No general bifurcation-tracking or large-scale performance claim.

Related method pages lead to separate editions for automatic differentiation, sensitivities, adjoints and coefficient fitting.
